text_simplified: This text discusses the tarbiyah (Islamic upbringing) of daughters in Islam and its importance. It mentions that proper Islamic tarbiyah of daughters leads to happiness in this world and the Hereafter. It also refers to Prophetic hadiths that encourage ihsan (excellence) toward daughters and patience in their tarbiyah. Additionally, it clarifies that whoever raises his daughters with ihsan will be rewarded greatly and will be a companion of the Prophet ﷺ in Paradise.

review_defects.english: and will be a companion of the Prophet ﷺ in Paradise
review_defects.why: The Arabic 'رفقة النبي' means 'the company/companionship of the Prophet', not 'a companion of the Prophet'. The English wording could imply the person becomes a Sahabi (Companion), which is not what the Arabic says.
